15:55: Hallucinations with closed eyes are intense.
15:57: The relaxation is comparable to that of hemp, the colors started to increase similar effects to LSD but it varies because the trip of 5-Meo-Dibf is makes the colors look more vivid but does not give the pleasant energy and euphoria of the LSD, it is a trip a quite gray, the sounds become metallic is not at all pleasant
16:30: I lie down to take a nap, impossible the energy that it caused did not allow me to sleep, I had constant muscular spasms especially in my arms.
17:17: Stimulate the appetite
18:30: The effects disappear.
